title: Shared definitions — every Berm public wire artifact

namespace.$comment: CLOSED at one value in V1. FD-BP-02 anticipates reddit, telegram, farcaster, github and domains; each is added by a separate method with its own identity, never by widening this enum in place.

methodId.$comment: MethodSpec §3.1. The R13-A R3 pattern was ^berm\.[a-z_.]+(\.[a-z]+)?/[0-9]+$, which admits no HYPHEN and so REJECTED TWO OF THIS PACK'S OWN IDENTIFIERS: berm.acquisition.x-direct-status/1 and berm.transport.x-syndication-via-same-origin-proxy/2. Measured against the R4 gate: SIX OF TWELVE wire/example artifacts fail the R3 pattern on acquisitionId, and nothing in the R3 build ever compared an example to a schema. tools/verify-wire-examples.mjs now validates every example against these schemas so a schema can never again reject the artifacts it governs. The version segment also tightened from [0-9]+ to [1-9][0-9]*, which excludes /0 and leading zeros.

signature.$comment: BIP-340 Schnorr over secp256k1, computed on the SHA-256 of JCS(artifact with `sig` omitted) — the SAME projection as artifactId, with no further exclusions. Lowercase hex.

binding.$comment: EXACTLY six members. `additionalProperties:false` is the schema-level expression of FD-BP-04 — a seventh field fails validation rather than travelling quietly.

artifactId.$comment: THE ONE PROJECTION: sha256 of the JCS (RFC 8785) serialization of the artifact with `sig` omitted — AND NOTHING ELSE. Every other field of every artifact is therefore signed and hash-identified. `policyHash` is computed as artifactId(policy) and is never carried inside a policy: R13-A REISSUE R2 omitted `policyHash` universally so a policy could hash itself, which also removed the RECEIPT's policyHash reference from its own signature — a receipt could be re-pointed at a different policy with no cryptographic trace.

xonlyKey.$comment: BIP-340 x-only public key, lowercase hex.
